steps.content: Christina has cracked the Mentor's puzzle. She isn't afraid of any other consequences and directly hacks open this glowing red storage cabinet with an axe.
Inside, there is only a flowery scroll, which looks exactly the same as the one she received before.
"Little one, you need to speed up your puzzle-solving."
If this was her first time here, Christina might have been upset by her, but now... Christina just feels like it's unnecessary.
The blade marks Christina just discovered... clearly weren't caused by Coquelic's power, but by another ability.
And the fact that Eugean's flowers can't be found anywhere indicates one thing: when Coquelic showed up, he couldn't grow a "flower" anymore.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Eugean was killed by another assassin... Coquelic made all this fuss just to help her cover everything up. That person is also a Sinner from the Garden, and, a very weak one.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Not only did she commit the crime against the Mentor's will and leave so many flaws at the scene, but she also forced the narcissistic Coquelic to give up her original perfect plan to help her cover up the scene... The criminal who attacked Eugean is definitely easier to deal with.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: She will be the breakthrough, but... what should I do?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Well done, Chris, leave the rest to me.
